purpose: Independent practice of C3.2 (read IF-THEN code).
student_learning_goal: I can read IF-THEN code and predict the outcome.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can read IF-THEN code and predict the outcome.
header.character_watermark: Inspector If in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Trace each IF-THEN code with the given input. Write the outcome.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four trace tables.

image_placeholders.description: Four trace tables in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each table: code on top, input cell, outcome cell. Pre-filled codes: 'IF >10 THEN BIG; ELSE SMALL', 'IF even THEN clap; ELSE stomp', 'IF =5 THEN star; ELSE plain', 'IF >20 THEN HIGH; ELSE LOW'. Inputs: 7, 4, 5, 25. Header 'Trace:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_TRACE: keywords (trace) name what the tables ask for.

parts.student_instructions: For each IF-THEN code, list 2 inputs that give TRUE outcomes and 2 inputs that give FALSE outcomes.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Three input-output tables.

image_placeholders.description: Three input-output tables in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each table: code on top, 'TRUE inputs: ___, ___' and 'FALSE inputs: ___, ___'. Codes: 'IF even THEN clap', 'IF >10 THEN BIG', 'IF multiple of 5 THEN star'. Header 'Find Inputs:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_INPUTS: keywords (inputs) name what the tables ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Sample: TRUE inputs (even/2,4,8), FALSE inputs (odd/3,5,7).

parts.student_instructions: Pick a code from above. Predict outcomes for 4 of your own inputs. Verify by re-tracing.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A blank verification table.

image_placeholders.description: A blank verification table in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. 'My code: ___'. 4 input-prediction-verified rows. Header 'Verify:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_VERIFY: keywords (verify) name what the table asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. All predictions must match traces.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, pick a 3-branch code and trace 5 inputs.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 worksheet practices C3.2 reading. Watch for input-doesn't-matter trap — children who predict the same outcome for every input.
